name: Qantas Airways Limited
summary: Qantas Airways Limited provides air transportation services in Australia and internationally. The company operates through Qantas Domestic, Qantas International, Jetstar Group, and Qantas Loyalty segments. It offers passengers and air freight services; and customer loyalty recognition programs. The company also provides freight services; and operates frequent flyer loyalty program. It operates under the Qantas and Jetstar brands. Qantas Airways Limited was founded in 1920 and is headquartered in Mascot, Australia.
